skills.description: Proof-of-concept synchronous fail-closed refund gate for e-commerce AI agents (business rules v1.0). Feed it order facts (already authenticated by the caller's OMS) and a refund request; it returns allow/deny/escalate and signs every verdict (including deny) with a 5-minute, offline-verifiable Ed25519 six-field receipt over JCS(RFC8785)-canonical JSON. Zero-dependency pure-Python RFC8032 client. Any timeout, network error, HTTP 402, non-200, missing/expired/tampered receipt or verdict mismatch is treated as deny (no payout). The gate never connects to the order database and never moves money; the merchant OMS performs the final payout. Use for "should this refund be auto-paid / refund risk control / stop an AI from issuing refunds / refund decision".
